name: automations
description: Tailors a repo's entire Claude Code config (.claude: CLAUDE.md, settings.json permissions/hooks/env, skills, agents, workflows, .mcp.json, output-styles) via a deterministic scanner plus a mandatory multi-check gate — nothing is written until the user ticks it. Ships a fail-closed guard-append-only hook, /release, and templates (hooks, domain reviewer agents generated per repo, permissions allowlist). Language-agnostic.
